results.title: A coordinated swarm
results.description: 6 steady keepers, 2 skeptics, 3 closers and a guardian. Late in each round the closers fill the gap, each up to a quarter of the line.

results.title: Nobody closes the gap
results.description: The same crowd without closers or a guardian. Pledges land wherever they land.

results.title: An overeager crowd
results.description: 10 holders who throw 20% of the line every round without looking. The fire roars, but the sparks are diluted.

results.title: Matchers instead of closers
results.description: 6 steady keepers and 4 matchers who copy what is already pledged. Momentum without anyone aiming for the line.

results.title: A fading community
results.description: The coordinated swarm, but each round 2% fewer keepers show up, and free riders join.
